title: hieracium bifidum subsp. obtextifolium
intro: Hieracium bifidum subsp. obtextifolium, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever reduction and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium bifidum subsp. obtextifolium include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
